$comment: Files under backend/app that still read the environment instead of a setting in config.py (scripts/check_config.py, issue #766). An entry may only shrink: lower it with --update.

migrations.py.why: ALEMBIC_DATABASE_URL, the hand-off to Alembic's env.py, which runs outside the app

nats_auth.py.why: takes the environment as a parameter so the credentials checks can be tested; NATS credentials files

nats_client.py.why: NATS_NAMESPACE, which the tests set per run

routers/support.py.why: AUDIT_LOG_PATH, to become a setting with agent_service.py's

services/integrations/webhooks.py.why: WEBHOOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS, a security switch the tests set

services/loop/worker/deliver.py.why: AGENT_WORKSPACE_ROOT, to become one setting with collect_code.py's and integration.py's

services/loop/worker/prompt_budget.py.why: PROMPT_BUDGET_<ROLE>, names built per role; becomes part of the model profile (phase B)

services/models/model_factory.py.why: AGENT_MODEL and AGENT_MODEL_<ROLE>, names built per role, and old model variables; the model profiles replace them (phase B)

services/planning/project_docs/collect_c.why: AGENT_WORKSPACE_ROOT, to become one setting with deliver.py's and integration.py's

services/planning/project_docs/export_pd.why: sets SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH for the PDF renderer and restores it: a write for a library, not a setting

services/platform/agent_service.py.why: AUDIT_LOG_PATH, which the tests set; to become a setting with support.py's

services/platform/service_accounts.py.why: takes the environment as a parameter so the service-account checks can be tested

services/producers/github_adapter.py.why: GITHUB_TOKEN read at call time before settings.GITHUB_TOKEN, so a token set after start-up is seen

services/release/integration.py.why: AGENT_WORKSPACE_ROOT, to become one setting with deliver.py's and collect_code.py's

services/workspace/sandbox_manager.py.why: SANDBOX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, KUBERNETES_NAMESPACE and SANDBOX_IMAGE of the Kubernetes sandbox
